أتعايا (form VI)
# أَتَعَايَا (ʔataʕāyā) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.jaː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# أُتَعَايَا (ʔutaʕāyā) /ʔu.ta.ʕaː.jaː/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
